newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Blue Star has 10 pct of McCollam.
newsitem.headline: Blue Star has 10 pct of McCollam.

text.p: Blue Star Office Technology, part of the U.S. Office Products Co vehicle bidding for New Zealand's McCollam Printers Ltd, had a voting stake equivalent to 9.99 percent as of Friday, the firms said in a stock exchange statement published on Monday.
Blue Star announced 10 days ago it planned to set a takeover bid for McCollam to be based on a public offer at NZ$2.75 per share, with separate arrangements for a family-held 38 percent stake.
The statement said Blue Star had bought 2.37 million shares on the market at $2.73 last Friday to raise its stake to the new level.
